publishModes.savedLocal.en: Saved securely on this device for this account.
publishModes.savedLocal.zh-Hans: 已为当前账号安全保存到本机。

publishModes.restoredLocal.en: Saved draft restored. Review it before continuing.
publishModes.restoredLocal.zh-Hans: 已恢复草稿，请检查后继续。

publishModes.noSavedLocal.en: No saved draft for this account and mode.
publishModes.noSavedLocal.zh-Hans: 此账号和模式暂无已保存草稿。

publishModes.storageFailed.en: Secure storage is unavailable. Your current draft remains on this screen.
publishModes.storageFailed.zh-Hans: 安全存储暂不可用，当前草稿仍保留在此页面。

publishModes.invalid.en: Check the required fields, event times and ticket windows. Publishing also requires a current club-leader role.
publishModes.invalid.zh-Hans: 请检查必填项、活动时间和票种履约窗口；发布还需要当前主理人身份。

publishModes.readFailed.en: The list didn't load. The network isn't connected. Try again.
publishModes.readFailed.zh-Hans: 列表没加载出来。网络没连上，请重试。

publishModes.clubOnly.en: Only club leaders can publish activities.
publishModes.clubOnly.zh-Hans: 仅俱乐部主理人可发布活动。

publishModes.conflict.en: The project changed or access is unavailable. Refresh before reviewing again.
publishModes.conflict.zh-Hans: 项目已变化或暂时无权访问，请刷新后重新审核。

publishModes.acknowledged.en: Submitted. Check My projects for the latest status.
publishModes.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 已提交，可在我的项目查看最新状态。

publishModes.notSent.en: Nothing was sent. Access, configuration or the reviewed data changed.
publishModes.notSent.zh-Hans: 未发送请求；权限、配置或审核内容发生变化。

publishModes.abandon.message.en: What you entered in this activity will not be kept.
publishModes.abandon.message.zh-Hans: 已填写的活动内容不会保留。

publishModes.mapUnavailable.en: Place search isn't available right now. Confirm a place to continue quick setup.
publishModes.mapUnavailable.zh-Hans: 地点搜索暂不可用；需确认地点后才能继续快速配置。

publishModes.searchPlace.en: Search for a place and select a result.

publishModes.timeRange.invalid.en: The end must be later than the start.
publishModes.timeRange.invalid.zh-Hans: 结束时间必须晚于开始时间

activityWizardValidation.start.en: Check the activity start date and time.
activityWizardValidation.start.zh-Hans: 请检查活动开始日期和时间。

activityWizardValidation.end.en: Enter a valid activity end date and time later than the start.
activityWizardValidation.end.zh-Hans: 请填写有效的活动结束日期和时间，且晚于开始时间。

activityWizardValidation.categories.en: Choose at least one valid activity category.
activityWizardValidation.categories.zh-Hans: 请至少选择一个有效的活动分类。

activityWizardValidation.template.en: Choose a play template for the activity.
activityWizardValidation.template.zh-Hans: 请为活动选择玩法模板。

activityWizardValidation.collaborators.en: Check collaborators. Select valid members without duplicates.
activityWizardValidation.collaborators.zh-Hans: 请检查协作者，选择有效会员且不要重复。

activityWizardValidation.tickets.en: Check the ticket details and add at least one ticket type.
activityWizardValidation.tickets.zh-Hans: 请检查票务信息，并至少添加一个票种。

activityWizardValidation.ticketName.zh-Hans: 第 %@ 个票种：请填写名称。

activityWizardValidation.ticketPrice.en: Ticket %@: enter a valid price of zero or more.
activityWizardValidation.ticketPrice.zh-Hans: 第 %@ 个票种：请填写有效且不小于零的价格。

activityWizardValidation.ticketStock.en: Ticket %@: enter a whole-number stock greater than zero.
activityWizardValidation.ticketStock.zh-Hans: 第 %@ 个票种：请填写大于零的整数库存。

activityWizardValidation.ticketStart.en: Ticket %@: check the start date and time.
activityWizardValidation.ticketStart.zh-Hans: 第 %@ 个票种：请检查开始日期和时间。

activityWizardValidation.ticketEnd.en: Ticket %@: enter valid start and end dates and times, with the end after the start and both within the activity period.
activityWizardValidation.ticketEnd.zh-Hans: 第 %@ 个票种：请填写有效的起止日期和时间，结束须晚于开始，且都在活动时段内。

activityWizardValidation.none.en: No field-specific validation message is currently shown.
activityWizardValidation.none.zh-Hans: 当前没有字段校验提示。

activityWizardValidation.unknown.en: Check the activity details before continuing. A field-specific explanation is unavailable.
activityWizardValidation.unknown.zh-Hans: 请检查活动信息后继续，暂无法提供具体字段说明。

activityPublishing.review.collaboratorNo.zh-Hans: 合作者可编辑内容，不参与结算

activityPublishing.review.merchantFreeNo.zh-Hans: 商家活动暂时只支持免费票

activityPublishing.review.createVisibili.en: Public by default: once published it appears in the activity list, and continuing publishes it with the current visibility.
activityPublishing.review.createVisibili.zh-Hans: 默认公开：发布后会在活动列表展示，继续即按当前公开范围发布。

activityPublishing.review.editVisibility.en: This save only updates the items above and doesn’t change who can see the activity.
activityPublishing.review.editVisibility.zh-Hans: 本次保存只更新上面这些内容，不会改变活动的公开范围。
